forwarder_said: "Confirmed, 5 pieces, 1,500 kg... the shipment now also includes lithium-ion batteries packed with the equipment. Paperwork to follow."
message_to_send: Dear Omar, thank you for letting us know. Because the shipment now includes lithium-ion batteries, booking B-05 is under review by our cargo acceptance team and is not yet accepted as changed. Please send the UN number and the signed Shipper's Declaration for Dangerous Goods. Solvane Air Cargo capacity team.
why: Trigger: the cargo itself changed (Escalation 2.6); the cargo acceptance team decides. Rules check: 7.1 declared as dangerous goods - not met (booking still GEN); 7.2 flight dg_accepted yes and forwarder dg_certified yes - met; 7.3 signed Shipper's Declaration - missing (paperwork to follow), UN number also missing (Rules 1.3); 7.4 batteries packed with equipment, not on their own - not applicable; 7.5 terminal DG acceptance check - still required. Release 0 kg. Sources: booking B-05, forwarder F-03, message M-05, Escalation 1.3, 2.6, Rules 1.3, 7.1-7.5.
